# Arch layer

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

The contract between the kernel and each architecture. `arch/include/arch` is what the kernel calls; `arch/<arch>/` is one port's implementation.

## arch/arm/include/arch_impl/

| Header | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`abi.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/abi.md) | ARMv7-A executable ABI: which images this architecture runs. |
| [`armv7_mmu.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/armv7_mmu.md) | ARMv7-A short-descriptor translation table formats and MMU register fields. |
| [`asid.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/asid.md) | ARMv7-A ASID width. |
| [`backtrace.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/backtrace.md) | ARMv7-A frame-pointer stack walk. |
| [`barrier.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/barrier.md) | ARMv7-A memory barriers. |
| [`counter.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/counter.md) | ARMv7-A counter read. |
| [`cpu.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/cpu.md) | ARMv7-A CPU control. |
| [`cycles.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/cycles.md) | ARMv7-A cycle counter. |
| [`fpu.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/fpu.md) | ARMv7-A VFP state and access control. |
| [`mmu.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/mmu.md) | ARMv7-A MMU helpers used while switching to the higher-half mapping. |
| [`regs.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/regs.md) | ARMv7-A register frames and the user register view. |
| [`svc.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/svc.md) | ARMv7-A syscall entry: the svc instruction and its registers. |
| [`thread.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/thread.md) | ARMv7-A thread pointer write. |
| [`tls.h`](arm/include/arch_impl/tls.md) | ARMv7-A thread pointer read. |
